data.one_liner: Integration for the Bloc state management library to Flame games.
data.what_it_does: Integration for the Bloc state management library to Flame games. It provides components and mixins like FlameBlocProvider, FlameBlocListener, and FlameBlocReader to bridge blocs and cubits with Flame game components.
use_when: You are building a game using Flame and want to manage state using the Bloc library.
Your Flame components need to access, read, or listen to bloc and cubit states.
avoid_when: You are not using the Flame game engine.
You prefer an entirely different state management approach inside your game.
strengths: Natural integration mirroring flutter_bloc patterns inside Flame.
Provides providers, multi-providers, listeners, and readers for flexible component architecture.
weaknesses: Mixins like FlameBlocReader are limited to accessing only a single bloc.
Tied strictly to the Flame game engine and Bloc library.
